description: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR (k145) is the user scope's .claude: the user config, the skill, its lock and the detection marker are read and written under ${HOME}/cfg; the decoy config under ${HOME}/.claude is ignored and stays untouched. The CLI keeps its own state in ${HOME}/cfg/skilletor: its check finds no record of the engine's sync there (varsChanged, exit 1) until its own sync writes one.
